subject: MAP: Integration Build Plan - SDK & Streaming (ACME)
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + MAP kickoff

Thanks Marissa — good call today. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks for the MAP so we can align on timeline: 

- Goal: Integrate Redwood inference for our in-app assistant to support streaming responses and structured tool-calling where user intents trigger internal actions. 
- Key milestones we care about: SDK integration, streaming setup, tool-calling hooks, structured outputs for downstream systems, QA + performance validation.

As discussed, target pilot by end of Q2. Can you please share a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestone owners and dependencies so I can socialize internally? Also include any necessary security / compliance pre-reqs for on-prem data access.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Johnson
Senior Product Manager, ACME Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Integration Build Plan (initial)

Hi Alex — great to meet yesterday. Attached is a first-pass MAP draft focused on the integration build plan:

Attachments: acme_map_draft_v2.docx, integration_diagram.png

Summary of proposed milestones (owners assigned):
1) SDK integration and authentication (Owner: Dev Patel, Redwood SE) — deliverables: SDK samples, auth flow, test harness. Target complete: 2027-04-01. Dependencies: ACME provide API keys and ephemeral test account.
2) Streaming & low-latency config (Owner: Jordan Blake, Redwood Eng) — deliverables: streaming demo, latency targets, queueing settings. Target complete: 2027-04-15. Dependencies: latency SLOs from ACME app and load profile.
3) Tool-calling hooks & structured outputs (Owner: ACME Eng / Owner: Jordan Blake for Redwood work) — deliverables: webhook schema, sample tool adapter, JSON-LD structured output spec. Target complete: 2027-04-29. Dependencies: agreed tool API surface and auth.
4) End-to-end QA & performance validation (Owner: Laura Bennett, Redwood PM) — deliverables: test plan, perf reports, fallback policies. Target complete: 2027-05-10.
5) Pilot launch & rollback plan (Owner: Alex Johnson / Marissa) — Target: 2027-06-30 (pilot).

Next steps: Dev and Jordan to run through the SDK/streaming feasibility doc this week and call out any blockers by 3/8. Alex — please confirm the ACME owners for tool-calling and share any security contacts.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Integration Build Plan (SDK questions + notes)

Alex/Marissa/Jordan — quick engineering follow-up after reviewing the draft MAP and the integration_diagram.png: 

1) SDK integration: Redwood JS/Go/Java clients already support streaming for token-by-token delivery; we'll provide sample code and a local test harness. Known constraint: mobile SDK adds ~30ms to first byte under current bench but fine for pilot. Action: I'll drop sample repo link and test instructions by 3/10.
2) Auth: We need ACME to provision a scoped API key for the pilot and a service account for webhook signing. Dependency: ACME security to confirm HMAC vs. JWT preference.
3) Tool-calling: To support ACME's internal ticketing action, we propose a webhook + signed-callback flow plus an optional adapter service. Jordan, can you confirm if Redwood will provide an adapter template?
4) Structured outputs: We'll expose a JSON schema and output mode (strict vs. permissive). Laura, can you align the acceptance criteria for structured outputs so QA knows what to validate?

Blockers: No platform blockers yet — only dependency on ACME security and a final decision on adapter ownership.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration Build Plan - SDK & Streaming (ACME)

Alex / team — quick update after internal run-through. Confirming owners and a few refined dates/notes for the MAP milestone: 

- SDK integration & auth (Dev Patel) — sample repo ready by 2027-03-10 (Dev delivered). Please validate with ACME devs.
- Streaming & perf tuning (Jordan Blake) — initial streaming config validated; will be ready for ACME staging test 2027-03-18. Action: Marissa to schedule staging access.
- Tool-calling adapter (Jordan & ACME Eng) — Redwood will provide an adapter template and deployment instructions; final ownership to be decided by ACME by 2027-03-22.
- Structured outputs & validation (Laura Bennett) — Laura to share the JSON schema and acceptance criteria by 2027-03-19.
- QA & perf (Laura) — Redwood will run a 2-day perf run on 2027-04-22 to validate latency under expected load.

Risks/Dependencies: ACME security to confirm key provisioning and webhook signing by 2027-03-12; otherwise this shifts the streaming staging date.

Please reply with any redlines — otherwise we'll mark the MAP milestone as 'Accepted (owners assigned)' and I will update the shared MAP draft in Drive.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
